name: Dia
soft_passes: #2 optically centred on x but seats slightly high on y; grid precision unverifiable at 204px
#3 distinctive brand-consistent silhouette but abstract (rising-sun / tooth / blob), not a literal-object metaphor
#4 blue-crown-to-warm-foot temperature travel survives 16px and IDs the app; the concave bottom scallop smears to a plain dome
#7 blue crown and coral foot clear 3:1 on white, but the pale horizon band dissolves into the pedestal / near-invisible middle in grayscale
failures: #6 palette economy: four hue families in one glyph (blue->cyan-neutral->yellow->orange->red), no reserved accent — deliberate signature, but breaks the <=2-family ideal
#10 variant robustness: identity is spectrum-dependent; a tinted/mono render flattens the sunset to one hue and erases the mark, and the pale horizon band leans on the white ground

palette.background: ramp #FFFFFF->#E7E7F3 (near-white pedestal, cool lavender foot; blob contact-tint #E5E5F3)

light_model: soft top-down ambient + subtle specular sheen on the blob crown; translucent glass tints a cool lavender contact-halo into its near-white pedestal instead of casting a grey drop shadow (Liquid-Glass 'glass tints its ground')
layer_stack: soft lavender contact-tint under the blob (#E5E5F3)
translucent spectrum-glass blob (blue crown -> pale horizon -> coral foot, scalloped bottom edge)
specular highlight rim on the blob crown
devices: sunset/aurora spectrum ramp poured into a brand shape (blue->red vertical temperature travel = the memorable move)
scalloped-bottom gumdrop mark (abstract non-object logomark, dome top + concave wave base)
glass-on-white pedestal (translucent coloured layer tinting its ground, lavender contact-halo not grey shadow)
rhymes_hint: spectrum-gradient organic brand blobs — Arc browser's gradient mark, Apple Photos/Siri spectral orbs, Raycast-class gradient marks; a single organic shape poured full of a sky ramp
notes: 204x204 PNG web render (not the 1024 master); corners already alpha-masked into the file (web-delivery artifact, not evidence about the shipped square unmasked layers). All hex (measured) from this render, gradient stops (estimated) — banding, true specular treatment and any edge refraction are below this resolution. Non-negotiable checks 1-4 all pass. Both failures (#6, #10) stem from the same choice — the full spectrum — so this is a signature-driven, not sloppy, icon. Brand-context: cover pairs a MONOCHROME WHITE version of the identical blob + an editorial serif 'Dia' wordmark on stark black; palette deliberately does not carry between icon and cover (shape is palette-agnostic, sunset reserved as the app's face). Candidate seed for icon cluster 'spectrum-gradient organic brand blob' — needs >=3 independent icons before ICONS.md promotion.
